similarity: cosine of log1p historical >30% airing counts, row L2
weights: nonnegative cosine; selected positive weights normalized to sum1 per target
score: weighted average of neighbor binary item interactions, not calibrated watch probability
fallback: same >30% historical unique-user popularity for cold users or missing positive score slots
labels: none used to form similarities or scores; eval/later use frozen strict truth
outputs: dense target-by-future-candidate scores and row features aligned to context_features
selection: exploratory on previously explored overlapping validation windows
